title: Beastmaster: the bear
description: The bear for the Beastmaster mod: a new bear model (made with Meshy, on the game wolf's skeleton and animations), big and tough. Wild bears appear now and then when Beastmaster is installed; tame one and call it.
notes: The sources are not in the repository (about 12 MB): the glb, the albedo levels and the game dumps; the paths below point to a local folder. Build: python -I tools/models/make_mod.py tools/models/packs/beastmaster_bear.json
The GUIDs are fixed forever: mods/beastmaster/species.lua and players' saves refer to them.

Stats against the game wolf (Enemy_Wildbeast_wolf_earlygame): ScaleComponent 1.4; DamageMod_Multiplier (DamageMod dataStorage[2]) x1.5; Movement Sneak/Walk/Run/Sprint/Combat/Patrol/Flee (dataStorage[2..6], [8], [9]) x0.85. Health x2.5 comes from the Beastmaster mod at runtime (health.lua): the template has no base health of its own.
